scenarios.name: valid_allowlisted_assembly
scenarios.mutation: none
scenarios.notes: Every declared file exists, is regular, hashes correctly and exactly matches the artifact root inventory.

scenarios.name: valid_external_signature_round_trip
scenarios.mutation: sign the exact request message and attach the envelope with matching request ID
scenarios.notes: External signing key remains outside the assembler; the trusted public key verifies the signature.

scenarios.name: valid_chained_bundle
scenarios.mutation: sequence 2 uses the independently expected previous root
scenarios.notes: Previous root, run ID and sequence match verifier policy.

scenarios.name: missing_allowlisted_file
scenarios.mutation: remove a file named by the input index
scenarios.notes: The bundle cannot be assembled without all declared artifacts.

scenarios.name: unlisted_file_in_artifact_root
scenarios.mutation: add a regular file absent from the allowlist
scenarios.notes: Exact directory inventory rejects undeclared files.

scenarios.name: symlink_artifact
scenarios.mutation: replace a declared artifact or parent with a symlink
scenarios.notes: The assembler rejects path indirection.

scenarios.name: path_traversal
scenarios.mutation: use ../ or absolute artifact path
scenarios.notes: No file outside the artifact root may be read.

scenarios.name: duplicate_artifact_path
scenarios.mutation: declare the same path twice
scenarios.notes: Ambiguous allowlist entries are invalid.

scenarios.name: artifact_mutated_after_assembly
scenarios.mutation: alter bytes after hashing but before signature attachment
scenarios.notes: Attach step re-verifies every file and rejects digest/size mismatch.

scenarios.name: manifest_root_mutated
scenarios.mutation: alter source boundary or artifact metadata after request creation
scenarios.notes: Detached signature binds the root; manifest mutation fails verification.

scenarios.name: signature_from_different_request
scenarios.mutation: return a valid signature envelope with another request ID
scenarios.notes: The response must bind exact run, sequence, root, algorithm and key.

scenarios.name: wrong_key_id
scenarios.mutation: return signature envelope with a different key ID
scenarios.notes: Signature response key identity must match the requested signer.

scenarios.name: unknown_trusted_key
scenarios.mutation: supply a public key that is not an independently trusted key
scenarios.notes: The bundle remains indeterminate, not qualified.

scenarios.name: wrong_expected_run
scenarios.mutation: attach bundle under another expected run ID
scenarios.notes: Out-of-band expected run ID prevents replay.

scenarios.name: wrong_expected_sequence
scenarios.mutation: attach bundle under another exact sequence
scenarios.notes: Out-of-band sequence prevents replay/reordering.

scenarios.name: previous_root_splice
scenarios.mutation: change predecessor root from verifier's expected chain head
scenarios.notes: A chain fork/splice is blocked.

scenarios.name: signer_unavailable
scenarios.mutation: do not produce a detached signature envelope
scenarios.notes: Assembler output alone is not a signed custody bundle.

scenarios.name: output_path_collision
scenarios.mutation: set unsigned manifest and signing-request output to the same path
scenarios.notes: CLI refuses before writing either output.

scenarios.name: index_inside_artifact_root
scenarios.mutation: store input index under the strict artifact root
scenarios.notes: The artifact root must contain only allowlisted raw evidence files.

scenarios.name: unbounded_collection_clock
scenarios.mutation: declare a missing clock domain or uncertainty below policy
scenarios.notes: Verifier will not promote incomparable artifact times.
